name: Wordsmith
descr: Play the Wordsmith if you want to use clever wordplay and captivate crowds.

foundations.name: Rousing Speech
foundations.text: Once per long rest, you can give a heartfelt, inspiring speech. All allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.

foundations.name: Heart of a Poet
foundations.text: After you make an action roll to impress, persuade, or offend someone, you can **spend a Hope** to add a **d4** to the roll.

specializations.name: Eloquent
specializations.text:
Your moving words boost morale. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, you can do one of the following:

- Allow them to find a mundane object or tool they need.
- Help an Ally without spending Hope.
- Give them an additional downtime move during their next rest.

masteries.name: Epic Poetry
masteries.text: Your Rally Die increases to a **d10.** Additionally, when you Help an Ally, you can narrate the moment as if you were writing the tale of their heroism in a memoir. When you do, roll a **d10** as your advantage die.
